✨ deviload | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A desktop application for easily downloading and managing video and audio content from online sources, with a focus on YouTube.
✨ Key Features: • Downloads from YouTube and other yt-dlp supported sites • Supports various video and audio formats (MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, FLAC, WAV) • One-click download with link preview (title, duration, streams) • Playlist management (whole list, ranges, chapter splitting)
📖 Summary: Deviload is a clean, user-friendly desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading videos and audio from various online platforms. It leverages yt-dlp for robust downloading capabilities, offering features like playlist management, chapter splitting, GIF creation, and direct YouTube sign-in.
